fusions.name: Headlock
fusions.desc: Locks the target's head against your horns and wrenches it: deals 14 damage, holds it [Stunned] for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Chest-Drum Stomp
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. You pound your chest and stamp, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Challenge Display
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Oxbone Cudgel
fusions.desc: Conjures a thighbone cudgel. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.
